diagnosis: Candidate 3.9.3-dev.57 looked up image references only in imageSources. The editor can normalize an image source while retaining its reference in embeddedAssets, so the fallback mapping was lost and images could stop loading.
changes: Restore image reference lookup through imageSources and embeddedAssets for normal note rendering and PDF image preparation.
Skip data:image sources that are already decoded, avoiding redundant requests for images already displayed.
Keep in-flight request tracking and failure retry behavior from the PDF multi-image work.
